name: Toggl 2.0 Time Tracking
description: Query Toggl 2.0 time entries, resolved to project/client/task/tag names, with named periods (today, week, lastMonth…), a per-client duration roll-up, the timer running now, and the workspace's projects. Requires a TOGGL_API_KEY secret (Toggl 2.0 profile → API key, toggl_sk_…) and the organization_id setting (first number in the Toggl 2.0 URL). Read-only; one request per call against Toggl's hourly quota, which it reports on every answer.

organization_id.label: Organization id
organization_id.hint: The bare number from the Toggl 2.0 URL: focus.toggl.com/<organization id>/workspaces/<workspace id>/…. Required: the API offers no way to look it up with an API key.

workspace_id.label: Default workspace id
workspace_id.hint: The bare number from the Toggl 2.0 URL: focus.toggl.com/<organization id>/workspaces/<workspace id>/…. Optional: defaults to the workspace the account has open.
